Bates numbering

Sequential legal numbering with an optional stamp.

Stamp a consistent, zero-padded Bates number on discovery documents, with a prefix, suffix, custom start value and optional confidentiality stamp.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Bates numbering works

  1. Add a PDF and set the prefix, start number and digits.
  2. Choose the corner, colour, margin and optional stamp.
  3. Apply, then download the numbered record.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.
